before_task.title: Reject incompatible learning writes and omit mismatched live snapshots
before_task.scope: Six-file forward accumulation tuple guard and actual live snapshot matching; no clean-origin/history/generation claim.
non_goals: Forward reward/objective/tau compatibility containment only, anchored to existing stored config; it does not prove legacy item or slot counts were accumulated cleanly. No reset, generation transition, migration, automatic replay, historical rewrite/rebuild/promote or stronger delivery claim. Missing legacy snapshot horizon is omitted from live learning, not repaired. Old binaries, policy/denominator transitions, latent reward filter, prior/money/currency/refund/margin-fallback semantics, old hourly/report data and authorized history recovery remain W24/W22/W30 obligations. Estimator-only settings remain editable; active-request snapshot matching is not atomic configuration rollout. Pure archived replay remains compatible. No additional runtime network hop or broad suite; full W24/F19/F08/N17/customer/SLO/release remain open. No external/cloud/resource/credential/customer-data/deployment/commit/push/destructive cleanup authority.

criteria.description: Explicit valid write configuration required; incompatible reward/objective(default unit)/tau refused before item/slot mutation, put or alarm. Estimator-only changes retain counts. Interleaved old/new calls and restart/publication cannot oscillate accumulation tuple. Legacy config anchor is forward-only, not clean-history attestation.

Snapshot horizon metadata emitted; actual live service checks every fresh/cached snapshot owner, reward, objective, tau and estimator settings against request configuration. Missing legacy horizon or mismatch omits learned evidence; compatible cache remains usable. No extra I/O, pure archived replay/liftFor and deterministic core preserved.

Six owned deltas, two new grouped tests/fixed9; compiler/scopedlint0errors/no increase3/whitespace, separate frozen source/runtime review. Preserve prior capacity/receipt/arithmetic/privacy paths and explicit policy/history/generation/money/customer residuals.
